name: think-digital-agency/contao-grid-plugin
description: Contao Grid Plugin — lightweight multi-breakpoint grid for Contao content elements. Adds column/offset settings to every content element and a grid wrapper start/stop pair, emitting Bootstrap-style col-* / offset-* classes. Replaces dma/dma_simple_grid without its multicolumnwizard dependency. Contao 5 and 6.
